_comment: Display Template preset: a hub Response with a linked List. See ../../codebot/display_template.md#display-presets. Copy this file's 'rules' array into your project's display.json (../../reference/presentation.md#display-template-file) and rename every placeholder below to your own schema names, then remove this and the '_placeholders' member.

_placeholders.Hub: The leading Response variant with a List of linked rows: '^<Hub>' selects it, and 'items' below is that List's own field name. 'detail' is an optional array: add a selector for each other linked node to highlight while its editor is open.
_placeholders.EditItem: The editing Request variant that opens beside Hub in the trailing pane; 'right_pane' lists every editing Request that belongs there (../../reference/presentation.md#master-detail-panes).
_placeholders.OpenHub: The pure navigation Request whose NextResponse admits Hub; 'refresh' sends it to load and refresh the leading page. Every field it has is Hidden or ReadOnly and filled by Fixed, Default or CopyFrom from Hub and from each 'right_pane' editor.
_placeholders.Item: The List's member type, a Table with a Link to open its row: '^<Item>' selects it wherever it occurs.
_placeholders.status: A field of Item, an Enumeration whose members the :condition rules below name; rename NeedsAttention/Continue/Done to your own members.
_placeholders.OpenItem: the Request variant that Item's own Link attribute names in the schema; it is not a selector in this file.
